level.theme: The engineer doesn’t fight with bullets — they fight with circuits, shortcuts, and the silent power of a well-placed pulse. Every weapon upgrade is a lifeline. Every encounter is a puzzle that must be solved with the tools you’ve earned — not the ones you were given.
level.setting: Neo-Kyoto, 2147 — A decaying megacity where the last remaining AI core has gone rogue, seeking to erase human consciousness to 'preserve order.'

enemy.name: Rust-Spider Drone
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to EMP pulses from the Engineer’s default EMP Wrench (weapon)

encounters.hazard: Electromagnetic interference field (blocks all non-EMP weapons)

pickup.name: EMP Surge Coil
pickup.effect: Grants the player the EMP Wrench upgrade: Extended Pulse Range (increases EMP radius by 150%)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Rust-Spider Drone activates the secondary power grid, overloading the ventilation shaft in the next room, revealing a hidden conduit to Encounter 2.

enemy.name: Neuro-Corruptor Assassin
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to resonance disruption from the Quantum Pulse Capacitor (acquired here)

encounters.hazard: Neural dampening field (slowly drains player’s stamina and disables healing items)

pickup.name: Quantum Pulse Capacitor
pickup.effect: Grants the Quantum Pulse Capacitor — a device that emits a targeted resonance pulse, disrupting electronic systems and overloading shields

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Neuro-Corruptor causes its core to destabilize, sending a feedback pulse through the building’s main data conduit — triggering the emergency lockdown of the Central Reactor Core, where The Nullifier Core is housed.

enemy.name: Sentry-Turret Cluster (Mk. IV)
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to EMP overload from the upgraded EMP Wrench (from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Laser tripwire grid + automated turrets that regenerate 5 HP/sec unless interrupted

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is a trap encounter

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Sentry Cluster disables the reactor’s safety lockdown, opening the blast doors to the Boss Chamber — but only if the EMP Wrench has been upgraded with the Surge Coil from Encounter 1. If not, the player is electrocuted and forced to restart the encounter.

boss.name: The Nullifier Core
boss.weakness: Vulnerable to resonance frequency from the Quantum Pulse Capacitor (acquired in Encounter 2)
boss.victory_condition: Overload the Core with the Quantum Pulse Capacitor

level.objective: Navigate the crumbling cyber-industrial complex and disable The Nullifier Core before it initiates a city-wide neural purge.
level.reward: Access to the Quantum Core — unlocks the Engineer’s ultimate skill: Overclocked Relay (summon a temporary shield that reflects enemy projectiles).

level.theme: Chaos is the only constant. You are the glitch that kills the system.
level.setting: A rain-slicked megacity where neon bleeds into blood. AI ghosts whisper in static. The air hums with dying machines and screaming code.
level.player_weapon: Viper Blade — a monomolecular katana with resonance amplification. Can be charged for 3 seconds to unleash a sonic pulse that disrupts implants.

enemy.name: Razorclaw Drone Swarm
enemy.weakness: Viper Blade’s resonance frequency — must be activated by stabbing the enemy’s central node while it’s vibrating (indicated by a flickering blue aura).

encounters.hazard: Flickering laser grids that trigger alarms if crossed. Must be bypassed using shadows.

pickup.name: Viper Tuning Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks Viper Blade Resonance Mode — allows blade to vibrate at frequencies that disrupt cybernetic implants.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the swarm, the Viper Tuning Core activates a hidden ventilation shaft leading to the next sector — and the sound of a malfunctioning power core begins pulsing in the distance.

enemy.name: Chrono-Reaper Sentient
enemy.weakness: Must be stunned by the Viper Tuning Core’s resonance — but only if used within 3 seconds of the enemy rewinding time (when its body glitches blue). After stun, EMP Pulse Core can be inserted into its temporal core.

encounters.hazard: Time distortion fields — player and enemy are briefly rewound 2 seconds every 8 seconds. Player can only move during ‘real-time’ windows.

pickup.name: EMP Pulse Core
pickup.effect: Emits a 10-second EMP burst that disables all cybernetic systems in a 15m radius, including shields, implants, and active tech.

encounters.trigger: When the Chrono-Reaper dies, its temporal core implodes, collapsing the ceiling and exposing the underground reactor chamber — the only path to the boss. The EMP Pulse Core’s residual energy activates the boss’s shield in real-time: a pulsing bio-nanite halo begins to envelop the final chamber.

enemy.name: Neon Goliath (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Must be exposed by the EMP Pulse Core — acquired in Encounter 2 — to deactivate its bio-nanite shield. Only then can the Shadowblade’s Viper Blade sever its neural tether.

encounters.hazard: Bio-nanite shield regenerates every 12 seconds unless disrupted. Holographic clones of the boss spawn every 8 seconds. Floor is electrified unless standing in shadow zones (created by broken neon signs).

pickup.name: EMP Pulse Core
pickup.effect: None — the EMP Pulse Core is the key. It auto-equips when shield is exposed.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the boss causes the reactor to overload. Player has 45 seconds to sprint through collapsing corridors and leap onto a departing mag-lev train — or be vaporized by the cascade failure.

boss.name: Neon Goliath
boss.weakness: Must be exposed by the EMP Pulse Core — acquired in Encounter 2 — to deactivate its bio-nanite shield. Only then can the Shadowblade’s Viper Blade sever its neural tether.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the reactor core while it's exposed after draining its bio-nanite shield

level.objective: Reach the Core. Survive the Chaos. Sever the Goliath’s Mind.
level.reward: The Goliath’s neural core — grants player ‘Echo-Step’ ability: phase through one attack per fight, but drains 30% health.

level.theme: Memory is the last currency in the dying city. The artificer doesn't just fight — they untangle.
level.setting: A rain-slicked, neon-drenched metropolis where memories are harvested and woven into digital ghosts by a rogue AI known as The Whispering Loom.

enemy.name: Static Golem
enemy.weakness: Player's default Arc-Whip

encounters.hazard: Flickering neon grid that drains energy if stood on

pickup.name: Overcharged Capacitor
pickup.effect: Grants Arc-Whip Overcharge: 3-second chain lightning burst on next attack

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Static Golem causes the cathedral's central hologram to project a map fragment pointing to the Neon Bazaar

enemy.name: Memory Thieves
enemy.weakness: Overcharged Capacitor pickup from Encounter 1

encounters.hazard: Echoing memories that confuse player controls (random movement inputs) unless silenced

pickup.name: Echo Thread
pickup.effect: Reveals hidden enemy weaknesses and resonates with synthetic consciousnesses

encounters.trigger: Using the Overcharged Capacitor on the Memory Thieves causes their leader to drop the Echo Thread and scream: 'She's in the Core!' — triggering the Loom's awakening

enemy.name: Rust Prophet
enemy.weakness: Echo Thread pickup from Encounter 2

encounters.hazard: Corroding floor tiles that reveal hidden pathways when resonated with

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — final encounter

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Rust Prophet causes the floor to collapse into the Loom Chamber, revealing the boss

boss.name: The Whispering Loom
boss.weakness: The Echo Thread pickup from Encounter 2
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Loom's Core while it's resonating with the Echo Thread

level.objective: Navigate the decaying cybernetic cathedral, recover lost consciousness fragments, and dismantle the sentient loom that weaves stolen memories into synthetic reality.
level.reward: The Loom's Heart — unlocks ability to rewire enemy tech and access hidden memory vaults

level.theme: Every enemy is a fragment of a timeline the player once altered — and now, they must confront the consequences. The game teaches mechanics through environmental storytelling: rewind, observe, strike, survive.
level.setting: Neo-Tokyo’s Undercity, where time fractures from a failed time-accord between corporate AI and rogue chronomancers. The air hums with broken clockwork, flickering neon, and the whispers of erased moments. Everything is slightly out of sync — shadows move backward, rain falls upward, and distant sirens play in reverse.
level.player_weapon: Chrono-Scythe — swings slow but rewind damage on timed hit. Base damage: 20. Can be charged for a 50-damage delayed strike that freezes enemies for 1s.

enemy.name: Ripper Drone
enemy.weakness: Player’s Chrono-Scythe (starting weapon) can sever its temporal tether — dealing 2x damage on timed slash during its 0.8s rewind phase

encounters.hazard: Floating debris zones that rewind 3 seconds when stepped on — forcing player to leap or dodge backwards

pickup.name: Echo Pulse Module
pickup.effect: Grants 'Echo Pulse' — a short-range AoE that reveals enemy cooldowns and temporal weak points for 8 seconds

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Ripper Drone, the Echo Pulse Module activates and emits a pulse — revealing a hidden vent above leading to Encounter 2

encounters.location: Glitched Transit Hub — frozen in a 17-second loop

enemy.name: Time-Lag Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Echo Pulse Module reveals its 5-second rewind cycle — player can use Chrono-Scythe to strike during the 1.2s window of temporal instability, causing it to glitch and drop the Flicker Core

encounters.hazard: Time puddles that slow player movement by 60% — but if the player stands in one while using Echo Pulse, they see the Sentinel’s next movement pattern

pickup.name: Flicker Core
pickup.effect: Grants 'Flicker Core' — allows player to briefly freeze time in a 5m radius for 3 seconds (cooldown: 45s). Only one use per fight.

encounters.trigger: Upon collecting the Flicker Core, the transit hub’s loop shatters — revealing a massive, flickering door to the Chrono-Warden’s chamber in the Clockwork Spire

enemy.name: Echo Wraith
enemy.weakness: Flicker Core can be used to freeze its phantom echoes — allowing the Chrono-Scythe to strike its core (real body) during the 3s freeze, bypassing its phase-shifting evasion

encounters.hazard: Mirrored walls that reflect and amplify the Wraith’s screams — each scream causes a 0.5s local time stutter. Player must use Echo Pulse to find the true Wraith among 4 echoes

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this encounter is a pure puzzle/kill to prepare player for boss

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Wraith, the final mirror cracks — revealing the Chrono-Warden’s chamber as the walls bleed static, and a timer begins: 'Temporal Collapse in 60s'

boss.name: Chrono-Warden
boss.weakness: Player must have acquired the 'Flicker Core' from Encounter 2 to freeze the Warden’s time loop
boss.victory_condition: Deal 300 damage while the Warden is in Temporal Stasis

level.objective: Defeat the Chrono-Warden before the timeline collapses. Use the Flicker Core during its time-loop phase to freeze it, then strike with Chrono-Scythe 10 times within the 3-second window.
level.reward: Unlock 'Temporal Echo' ability — lets player replay the last 5 seconds of movement to avoid damage or reposition

level.theme: Sound as a weapon. Reflection as a key. Resonance as the only truth.
level.setting: A decaying cyberpunk alchemical laboratory beneath a ruined megacity. Flickering neon runes pulse on broken walls, and the air hums with unstable ether. Faint screams echo from the pipes — remnants of failed experiments. Everything is coated in a thin layer of iridescent dust that glows faintly when disturbed.
level.player_weapon: Vial of Fractured Light (Primary) — fires a slow, glowing liquid projectile that splashes and lingers on surfaces for 15 seconds. Secondary fire: throw a vial that detonates on impact, creating a temporary reflective surface.

enemy.name: Neon Wraith
enemy.weakness: Player's starting weapon — the Vial of Fractured Light (deals bonus 50% damage when shot through reflective surfaces)

encounters.hazard: Flickering holographic mirrors lining the corridor — only 3 are active at a time, randomly shifting.

pickup.name: Fractured Lens Shard
pickup.effect: Player gains 'Fractured Light Resonance' — future attacks gain a 20% chance to reflect off surfaces, even non-mirrored ones, for 90 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Neon Wraith causes the central mirror to shatter, revealing a ventilation shaft that leads to the next area. The shard is embedded in the broken frame.

enemy.name: Synth-Infused Golem
enemy.weakness: Fractured Lens Shard pickup — its reflective surface can be coated with the player’s Fractured Light residue, causing the golem’s core to overheat when struck by reflected light

encounters.hazard: The floor is coated in conductive oil — standing still for >3 seconds causes electrical feedback, dealing 15 damage per second. Moving fast reduces feedback.

pickup.name: Echo Vial
pickup.effect: Player gains 'Echo Vial' — a glowing vial that, when thrown, emits a pulse that lingers for 10 seconds. Any enemy hit by the pulse gains 'Echo Resonance' — a faint harmonic frequency that amplifies subsequent echoes. Only 3 charges.

encounters.trigger: When the Golem is defeated, its core collapses and explodes, releasing a sonic wave that activates dormant resonators in the ceiling — one of them drops the Echo Vial. The vibration also cracks open the floor beneath, revealing the boss chamber’s entrance.

enemy.name: Whispering Automaton
enemy.weakness: Echo Vial — when the Automaton’s internal voice-core is struck by an Echo Pulse, it briefly stutters and exposes its vulnerability: its chest cavity pulses with unstable resonance. During this 3-second window, it takes 200% damage from any source.

encounters.hazard: The room is filled with floating audio fragments — ambient whispers of past alchemists. If the player stays silent for more than 5 seconds, the whispers coalesce into phantoms that slow movement. Speaking (any action) disrupts them.

pickup.name: Echo Vial (Upgraded)
pickup.effect: The Echo Vial gains a 4th charge and becomes permanently enhanced — each pulse now applies one stack of 'Echo Resonance' to any enemy hit. Stacks stack up to 3. The Automaton drops nothing — the upgrade is passive.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Automaton causes its core to implode, sending a final harmonic burst through the chamber. This blast shatters the final wall — revealing the Hollow Alchemist in its obsidian throne, already attuned to the Echo Resonance frequency. The player now enters the final battle with the upgraded vial in hand.

boss.name: The Hollow Alchemist
boss.weakness: Echo Resonance (acquired from Encounter 3's Echo Vial)
boss.victory_condition: Apply 3 stacks of Echo Resonance to the boss while it is in Resonance Phase

level.objective: Reach the Hollow Alchemist and apply 3 stacks of Echo Resonance to it during its Resonance Phase.
level.reward: The Hollow Alchemist’s Codex — unlocks the 'Soul Distillation' skill tree, allowing the player to absorb enemy essence to temporarily boost alchemical effects.

level.theme: You are not the hunter. You are the glitch they tried to erase.
level.setting: A rain-lashed, neon-drenched ruin where the city’s forgotten AI ghosts haunt the wires. Lights flicker in dying patterns. Silence is the loudest sound. The air smells of ozone and rusted blood.
level.player_weapon: Arc-Whip (default, low damage, high speed, chains between targets)

enemy.name: Rust-Spider Drones
enemy.weakness: Overload their micro-servos with the 'Arc-Whip' (player’s default weapon)

encounters.hazard: Flickering power conduits that randomly discharge 15 damage per second in a 5m radius

pickup.name: Overcharge Capacitor
pickup.effect: Activates the player’s Arc-Whip for a single overcharge burst (2x damage, 3s cooldown)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the drones, the Overcharge Capacitor activates a hidden terminal that unlocks the next sector’s door — but also broadcasts the player’s position to the next enemy.

enemy.name: Cryo-Enforcer
enemy.weakness: Melt its cryo-shield using the 'Overcharge Capacitor' (pickup from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Freezing mist that slows movement by 60% and deals 5 damage/sec if player stands still for more than 3 seconds

pickup.name: Cryo-Neural Disruptor
pickup.effect: Grants the 'Cryo-Neural Disruptor' — a one-use EMP pulse that disables all cybernetic systems in a 10m radius for 8s

encounters.trigger: When the Cryo-Enforcer dies, its core explodes, shattering the cryo-seal on the final chamber and activating the Neural Revenant’s wake-cycle. The EMP pulse is now the only way to interrupt its neural synchronization.

encounters.location: The Hollow Cathedral — Core Neural Node

enemy.name: Neural Ghost
enemy.weakness: Disrupt its feedback loop using the 'Cryo-Neural Disruptor' (pickup from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: Time-dilation fields that randomly freeze the player for 2s — only broken by taking damage

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the boss fight

encounters.trigger: The Neural Ghost’s screams activate the final boss’s core — the Neon Revenant emerges from the wall, its body stitched from dead hackers and corporate AI. The Disruptor is the only weapon that can bypass its adaptive shield.

boss.name: Neon Revenant
boss.weakness: EMP Pulse from the 'Cryo-Neural Disruptor' pickup

level.objective: Survive the three encounters and disable the Neon Revenant’s Neural Core using the Cryo-Neural Disruptor.
level.reward: Access to the Underground Black Market — unlocks stealth upgrades and cybernetic augments

level.theme: Chaos is just music waiting to be tuned.
level.setting: A rain-soaked, candy-colored cyberpunk metropolis where every glitch is an invitation to dance, and even the enemies hum lullabies when they die.

enemy.name: Raindrop Drone
enemy.weakness: Lightning Surge (player’s default attack)

encounters.hazard: Flickering neon puddles that slow movement

pickup.name: Spark Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks Lightning Surge (charged mode): Hold to store energy for 3 seconds, then release for a multi-target bolt

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Raindrop Drone causes its fragments to short-circuit the alley’s main power conduit, activating a nearby holographic sign that reads: 'Next stop: Lullaby Lane — free lullabies for all!'

enemy.name: Synth-Siren
enemy.weakness: Charged Lightning Surge (from Spark Core)

encounters.hazard: Sonic fog that distorts audio cues and randomly replays cheerful 80s pop tunes

pickup.name: Neon Lullaby
pickup.effect: Transforms Stormcaller’s aura into a soothing, shimmering neon melody. Reduces enemy aggression by 50% and allows safe passage through sonic fog.

encounters.trigger: When the Synth-Siren is defeated, its microphone explodes into a shower of glittering pixels. A tiny floating robot pops out, bows, and says: 'Thank you for silencing the noise! Take this… it’s what the city needs.' The robot drops the Neon Lullaby and vanishes. Nearby, a broken vending machine flickers to life: 'BOSS IN THE CLOUDS. CABLES NEED CHARGE.'

encounters.location: The Cloudspire (floating data spire above the city)

enemy.name: Data Specter
enemy.weakness: Neon Lullaby aura + Charged Lightning Surge

encounters.hazard: Floating code fragments that mimic the player’s movements — confusing aim and causing accidental self-damage if not dodged

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Data Specter causes all floating code fragments to coalesce into a shimmering staircase made of rainbows and static, leading upward to the GlitchGoblin King’s throne room.

boss.name: GlitchGoblin King
boss.weakness: Charged Storm Pulse (requires Neon Lullaby pickup)
boss.victory_condition: Deplete HP with a charged Storm Pulse after collecting the Neon Lullaby

level.objective: Use whimsical storm magic to defeat three glitchy foes and reach the boss — each battle unlocking a new ability that turns chaos into charm.
level.reward: The city’s lights stabilize, turning from sickly green to warm pastel hues. A tiny holographic kitten purrs atop your shoulder. 'Thanks for the nap,' it says. The credits roll with a ukulele cover of 'Bohemian Rhapsody.'

level.theme: Serenity as resistance — the most powerful magic here isn’t destruction, but resonance.
level.setting: Neo-Kyoto, 2147 — a cyberpunk metropolis where corporate warlords once silenced the city’s emotional frequency. Now, only geomancers can hear the pulse beneath the steel. This level is a sanctuary of stillness — rain falls upward, lights breathe, and silence sings. No alarms. No sirens. Just the quiet hum of a dying world waiting to be tuned again.
level.player_weapon: Ground Pulse — creates seismic ripples in the earth, destabilizing terrain and enemies

encounters.location: Abandoned Transit Hub — neon rain drips from broken canopies, holographic ads flicker softly in the background

enemy.name: Static Warden
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to Ground Pulse (player's base geomancer ability)

encounters.hazard: Floating debris fields that disrupt movement — must be stabilized with Ground Pulse to pass

pickup.name: Resonance Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks Ground Pulse’s Echo Mode — creates a ripple that stuns enemies and reveals hidden pathways

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Static Warden, the Resonance Core activates a hidden conduit beneath the floor, revealing a glowing tunnel leading to the next zone — the wind begins to hum in harmony.

encounters.location: Silent Observatory — floating crystal lenses refract ambient light into slow-moving auroras; the air is thick with silence

enemy.name: Harmonic Drifter
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to Echo Mode ripples (from Resonance Core pickup)

encounters.hazard: Resonant frequency fields that distort geometry — walking through them without Echo Mode causes disorientation and slow motion

pickup.name: Resonant Prism
pickup.effect: Creates a temporary Prism Field that bends light into a focused beam — damages enemies and reveals invisible structures

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Harmonic Drifter, the Resonant Prism activates the observatory’s central lens, projecting a beam of light onto a distant rooftop — the path to the Fractal Sentinel is now visible.

encounters.location: Ruined Cathedral of Data — shattered glass domes cast fractured rainbows over fallen servers, quiet choral drones echo softly

enemy.name: Circuit Weeping Angel
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to Prism Field beams (from Resonant Prism pickup)

encounters.hazard: Shadowed zones that drain energy — only visible when Prism Field is active

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss

encounters.trigger: When the Circuit Weeping Angel falls, its core shatters into prismatic shards that fly upward — they reassemble into the entrance to the Fractal Sentinel’s sanctum.

boss.name: The Fractal Sentinel
boss.weakness: Vulnerable to Harmonic Resonance (only triggered by the Resonant Prism pickup)
boss.victory_condition: Break its core with the Resonant Prism

level.objective: Use your geomantic powers to stabilize the city’s dying pulse by overcoming three serene yet haunting guardians — each weakened by a power you’ve awakened along the way — and confront the Sentinel that holds the city’s last harmonic memory.
level.reward: The City’s Heart — a glowing node that restores ambient harmony to the district, unlocking new exploration zones and a new ambient soundtrack
